Following what Martin asked here, 

I was also wondering when reporting the overall-fit statistics, which row and column we should report when using WLSMV to deal with ordinal data. 

Should we report the ROBUST RMSEA (column scaled),  ROBUST CFI (column scaled), and TLI (column scaled)? Or, just the ROBUST RMSEA (column standard), ROBUSt CTI (column standard), and TLI (column standard)? 

Looking forward to any clarification here. 



Warm regards, 
Lizzy
